groups.title: Social sign-in: 2 centred buttons on live vs a row of 8 in the design
groups.summary: The design shows a full-width row of 8 round social buttons (Google, Facebook, Apple, LinkedIn, Microsoft, LINE, KakaoTalk, passkey) starting at x=870. Live shows only Google and Facebook, centred at x=1034, so the remaining icons are missing and the matcher pairs the wrong icons (Microsoft vs Facebook colour).

groups.title: “Log in” link loses its orange on live (dark)
groups.summary: In the dark design the “Log in” link after “Already have an account?” is orange (#ff7900); on live it is the same white as the rest of the line, so it no longer reads as a link. The line itself is also a step lighter (#c9c9c9 → #e0e0e0).

groups.title: "Send me recommendations" checkbox missing on live
groups.summary: The design has an orange checked checkbox with the label "Send me recommendations" under the social buttons; live has no opt-in row at all.

groups.title: Create account button 6px taller, lighter fill (#5a5a5a vs #292929), faint label
groups.summary: The disabled Create account pill on live is 52px tall (design 46px), filled a much lighter grey #5a5a5a (design #292929), and its label nearly disappears against the fill. The corner-radius finding is the same button (both are pills).

groups.title: Live dark-mode greys ~1-2 steps lighter (labels, borders, icons)
groups.summary: Secondary greys on the form are consistently lighter on live: EMAIL/PASSWORD labels #aaa → #d4d4d4, subtitle #c9c9c9 → #e0e0e0, "or" #a4a4a4 → #cdcdcd, password eye icon #7d7d7d → #aaa, and input borders #555 → #7f7f7f. One token shift in the dark palette.

groups.title: 4px more gap under the subtitle on live
groups.summary: Live's "Create an account" heading block sits 5-7px higher and the gap under "Already have an account? Log in" grows 21→25px before the EMAIL label.

groups.title: Marketing headline 3px smaller on live
groups.summary: "Better work in half the time." on the left panel is set smaller on live (31px → 28px text height, line narrower).

groups.title: Legal copy rewritten (adds terms acceptance line)
groups.summary: Below the form, live adds "By signing up you accept our Privacy Policy, Terms & Licensing Agreement" before the reCAPTCHA notice, so the block is 4 lines instead of 2.

groups.title: Asset stats line differs (live numbers, no "added yesterday")
groups.summary: First check-list item on the marketing panel: design reads "Access 74,540,405 creative assets (89,304 added yesterday)", live "Access 60,869,326 creative assets". Sample data vs live data.

groups.title: Design button edges read as dividers
groups.summary: The two "dividers" at y=454 and y=499 are the top and bottom edges of the design's Create account pill, picked up as lines; the button itself is covered by the button group.
